items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I give her costumes and material to make a -- what's the name? I give her a suit, shoes, cane.

ctx.x: Yes, the first ones. And they tore down the Steel Pier and we played at Steel Pier, too. But they don't advertise that Buck and Bubbles were the negroes that played the Steel Pier, but they got everybody else's name up there like Lou Holtz and Milton Berle -- many of the acts that played there

but they didn't name Buck and Bubbles. We stand out like a sore thumb in the world of entertainment. We stand out like a sore thumb, believe me. You run it down, you'll find out. This girl, you know, when you get back to New York, you know, she was in the office. Run her down and see what she found out. Miss Johnson. Run her down. How do you think she's successful. What do you think is making her success -- John Bubbles 'cause I'm the only one living in those ages, you know. And through what she got from me, me…
Where you going to pick it up from?
